tasks.title: Create contributor governance entrypoint
tasks.objective: Add root CONTRIBUTING.md so an internal maintainer can identify the authoritative file, allowed edit surface, validation/test command, explicit testcase/frozen-file boundary, documentation maintenance rule, and forbidden shortcuts before changing MCP, validator, tests, or docs.
steps: Create root-level CONTRIBUTING.md and keep it concise; do not duplicate deep MCP, validator, harness, or semantic lifecycle specifications inline.

Explain fact-source priority: design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json for intent, OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md and tests/ARCHITECTURE.md for implementation/test contracts, .argo/temp/ImplementationToCodingHandoff.json for current Coding scope, package.json for runnable scripts, and design references for deep documentation.
Explain safe change surfaces for maintainers changing MCP, validator, tests, or docs, with CONTRIBUTING.md as the entrypoint and target Coding scope limited to this file under WP3.

Explain stage boundaries: IntentDesign owns intent graph changes, ImplementationDesign owns contracts/testcase entrypoints/handoff artifacts, CodingAndReparing owns only approved Coding targets, and required intent graph changes become ImplementationToIntentTraceProposal rather than direct Coding edits.

List validation commands from package.json, including npm run validate:system-architecture, npm run validate:handoff, npm run validate:handoff:implementation, npm run test:argo, and the explicit DOC-02 command ARGO_TESTCASE_ANCHOR=doc-02-contributor-governance-router node tests/explicit/entries/runDocumentationInformationArchitectureDecision.js.

Explain explicit testcase and frozen-file boundaries: Coding may edit CONTRIBUTING.md, while tests/explicit/entries/runDocumentationInformationArchitectureDecision.js, tests/architecture/documentation/contributor-governance-entrypoint.guard.js, OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md, tests/ARCHITECTURE.md, design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json, and .argo/temp/ImplementationToCodingHandoff.json are frozen.
Link to design/README.md, design/argo-harness/README.md, design/mcp/意图架构 MCP 功能列表.md, design/validator/intent-architecture-mcp-validation.md, tests/ARCHITECTURE.md, and package.json where relevant.

Name forbidden shortcuts: editing design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json directly during Coding, widening Coding scope beyond CONTRIBUTING.md, modifying frozen explicit tests/guards to pass, manually setting deliveryStatus, inventing absent contracts, copying deep design specs inline, or bypassing package.json validation commands.

Run ARGO_TESTCASE_ANCHOR=doc-02-contributor-governance-router node tests/explicit/entries/runDocumentationInformationArchitectureDecision.js and node tests/architecture/documentation/contributor-governance-entrypoint.guard.js; then run npm run validate:handoff:implementation and npm run test:argo to refresh runner-owned records.
